hero.headline: The Story is Speaking. Are You Listening?
hero.subheadline: A writing companion that works like divination—drawing out symbols, echoes, and hidden truths from your words.

howDifferent.title: How We’re Different
howDifferent.description: Other tools give answers. Ours gives openings. It doesn’t fix or prescribe. Instead, it whispers possibilities—like drawing oracle cards from your own story.

coreConcepts.title: Fragments
coreConcepts.description: The seeds of story, waiting to unfold.

coreConcepts.title: Storythreads
coreConcepts.description: Subtle weavings between fragments, like constellations across the night sky.

coreConcepts.title: Insights
coreConcepts.description: Reflective sparks that show you what your story wants to become.

features.title: Symbol Extraction
features.description: Discover archetypes, myths, and dream-images hidden in your text.
features.example: Your story evokes The Memoryless Ancestor. The grass feels like rebirth.

features.title: Dream-Prompt Generator
features.description: Invite visions and dreamlike expansions into your writing.
features.example: A fog-memory drifts between voices you thought were your own.

features.title: Divinatory Endings
features.description: Receive endings that feel fated, symbolic, and alive.
features.example: It ends in a still lake that remembers nothing.

features.title: Story Oracle Cards
features.description: See your work through a symbolic spread: Origin, Current State, Emergence.
features.example: Origin – What drives this? Current State – What is being lived? Emergence – What longs to be born?

features.title: Spirit Voice Rewriter
features.description: Let the land, river, or ancestor speak your words back to you.
features.example: The river says: I carry what you’ve forgotten, and I am not done with you.

audience.title: Who It’s For
segments: Writers who resonate with myth and dream
Storytellers seeking symbolic and spiritual depth
Creators exploring archetypes, ritual, and imagination

closingCTA.headline: Your story is already alive. This tool helps you meet it in the space between dream and waking.
